operatorDirect.tierResolution: For >100 kW, the separately published ultra-rapid tier supersedes the broader >25 kW rapid label.

notes: The occupancy component is published as a fee for remaining connected without energy consumption: 15 free minutes, then a power-tier-dependent per-minute fee.
The official BFC page publishes both >25 kW rapid and >100 kW ultra-rapid labels; the ultra-rapid tier is treated as the more specific rule for powers above 100 kW.
Electromaps is the current service operator for the SDEY network; third-party eMSP/operator retail prices may include an additional commission and must remain separate from SDEY direct pricing.
The SDEY page explicitly states that bank-card payment is currently unavailable on its network despite generic BFC guidance mentioning card terminals on some network stations.
summaryLines: SDEY Yonne is currently operated by Electromaps, which replaced Freshmile.
Direct public tariffs: <25 kW 0.40 EUR/kWh, >25 kW 0.50 EUR/kWh, >100 kW ultra-rapid 0.60 EUR/kWh.
When connected without consumption: 15 minutes free, then 0.30 / 0.40 / 0.50 EUR per minute by tariff tier.
Optional no-commitment subscription: 2.99 EUR/month, with 0.35 / 0.40 / 0.50 EUR/kWh subscriber prices.
QR, Electromaps app and Electromaps BFC RFID are supported; SDEY currently states that bank-card payment is unavailable on its network.
Third-party roaming/operator pricing may add a commission and remains separate from SDEY direct tariffs.
